system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

Your enhanced white blood-cells reduce the effect of any disease or pathogen by 1 die. If this reduces the damage dice to 0, the disease simply doesn’t affect you. Alternately, enhanced immunity provides complete immunity to a single known disease, regardless of its effects. More enhanced immunity requires additional enhancements and reduces disease damage by 1 die (or provides immunity to one additional specific disease) per additional enhancement, up to 5.
